method: Reviewed transcription of published chart labels plus verified ANTT rail snapshot
interpretation: Separate modal indicators; not a comparable modal split or complete shipment census
quality_notes: Do not sum unlike units or calculate freight modal shares from these indicators.
Road coverage is registered fleet history, not a road cargo volume series.

ANTT TRC 2025 cites approximately 1.4 billion tonnes on PDF page 61 and 1.165 billion on page 64 (printed pages 53 and 56); no road tonnage total is promoted here until that scope discrepancy is reconciled.
Pipeline gas source attribution differs between narrative (ANP) and chart (MME); chart attribution is retained. Oil pipelines cover Transpetro, not all operators.
Chart values retain source rounding; forecasts are not included.
